scope: Finite 36x12x1mm isolated nonmagnetic housing in analytical five-PM source, closed and 0.5mm one-sided slotted geometries. Conductivity 25MS/m, conductor speed 0.001m/s in stationary-PM frame. Induced magnetic reaction, nonlinear backplane response, memory, operating-speed drag and hardware accuracy are not qualified.
operating_speed_boundary: At 20m/s the same length/conductivity would give Rm about 22.6. The tool rejects that request; no v-squared extrapolation is accepted.

finite_element.backend: NGSolve 6.2.2608, quadratic electric potential plus independent mean-zero gauge multiplier
finite_element.equations: J=sigma*(-grad(V)+u cross B), div(J)=0, natural insulating exterior and slot walls

independent_gradient_benchmark.reference: Independent rectangular streamfunction Poisson/torsional-rigidity Fourier series, not used in FE assembly

independent_resistor_grid.implementation: Existing SciPy finite-volume resistor/charge-continuity solve, no exterior current edges, own gauge on each connected conductor. Proper 90-degree coordinate rotation aligns the same physical slot and source.

preserved_trials: initial independent comparison failed before execution because the base environment had no NGSolve; its failed receipt remains archived
earlier comparison reports retained before stricter receipt/input checks
